newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-INDIA RECALL SIDHU FOR TOUR OF WEST INDIES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA RECALL SIDHU FOR TOUR OF WEST INDIES.

text.p: Opener Navjot Sidhu has been recalled by India for their forthcoming tour of West Indies, his first overseas assignment since his walk-out in England last year.
India's selectors named Sidhu on Wednesday in a squad of 16 for the Caribbean where their itinerary, including five tests and four one-day internationals, starts next week.

Sidhu quit India's team midway through the England tour after being dropped for a one-day international, and subsequently served a 50-day disciplinary ban imposed by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).

He was brought back last October for a triangular limited overs tournament in India against Australia and South Africa, during which he injured an elbow. He then missed the recent tour of South Africa.
Sachin Tendulkar captains India in the Caribbean, with the selectors relying on the nucleus of the party who went to South Africa.
The tour opens with a four-day against Jamaica in Kingston starting on February 28. The first test is also in Kingston beginning on March 6.

Squad: Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Anil Kumble, (vice-captain), Navjot Sidhu, Ajay Jadeja, Vangipurappu Laxman, Saurav Ganguly, Mohammad Azharuddin, Rahul Dravid, Robin Singh, Sunil Joshi, Javagal Srinath, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruvilla, Dodanarsiah Ganesh, Nayan Mongia, Saba Karim.
